name: Home Row
summary: A delivery address picker where each saved address is a house on a street and a scooter rides to it
about: A checkout address step drawn as a small street: Home, Office and Parents are houses, and an empty plot waits for a new address. Choosing an address drops a map pin over its house, rides the delivery scooter there with leaning starts and stops, lights the windows and updates the delivery fee, arrival time and total in PKR. The new address form checks every field and, once saved, stacks bricks, drops a roof and lights a brand new house.
how: Tap a saved address or use Tab and Enter: the pin drops on its house and the scooter rides over
The delivery fee, arrival time and total change with the city of the address
Add a new address: fill in name, a 03xx mobile number, house and street, area and city
Wrong or empty fields turn red with a short hint; Save and build stacks a new house on the empty plot
Press Deliver here: the rider drops the parcel on the doorstep and the pin turns into a green tick
